name: MetaSDF
definition: A method for learning a prior over signed distance function (SDF) shape spaces by treating shape reconstruction as a meta-learning problem, where a neural network is specialized to a new shape via few steps of gradient descent on context observations.
summary: MetaSDF is a gradient-based meta-learning method for shape spaces that specializes neural networks via few gradient steps, offering order-of-magnitude faster inference than auto-decoders.
